_README: Author-supplied masses in GRAMS, one per library label. A scan cannot weigh anything, so these are the only masses in the system. Replace each 0 with the reading from a kitchen scale and restart the bridge. A value of 0 is treated as not weighed, so a max_weight rule will compile and then constrain nothing until every entry is positive.
source: FILL IN, for example: kitchen scale, Escali Primo, 1 g resolution, 2026-09-03
_README_flags: Author-declared item properties. `fragile` means nothing of a DIFFERENT kind may rest on it, though copies of the same kind may stack, so eggs stack on eggs but a potato never sits on an egg. These are declared here, never inferred from a label.
